structured.answer: I didn't get a clear answer. What I took away is that money sitting in the עו"ש with no interest doesn't grow, and the page says a קרן כספית beats the עו"ש unless I need the money the same day. So I'd probably move part of the 30k, but the page never tells me what the עו"ש costs me in shekels or what to do first.

stuck.why: On a page about the עו"ש it shows the money growing at 5% a year, but my account pays nothing and further down the page says money in the עו"ש doesn't grow. I didn't know which one to believe.
There's no explanation next to the pink, teal and grey lines, so I had to guess what each one is.
I was looking for how much it costs and only found 'לפי התעריפון של הגורם המציע', no number.
